claims.note: The reference describes a device for demolding confectionery items, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.

The reference describes a gripping arrangement with suction elements and a vacuum mechanism, but not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated laying device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose the grip portion being at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not describe a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.
This reference does not disclose a battery coupling point on a housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference discusses air chambers and flow resistance in suction elements but does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
